 WHEREAS 
 
 The Developer is the owner of a real estate project named and styled as “ [Project Name] ”, comprising ‘ ZAMEEN OPAL ’ consisting of inter alia residential apartments , studio apartments, penthouses , and commercial shops located at [Project Location] Plot No. 16 and 17, Land Breeze Society, Raiwind Road, Lahore (“ Project ”); 
 
 The Buyer has seen the plan for the Project and is desirous desires to purchase the fully constructed penthouse(s)/ apartment (s) /shop ( s ) together with all the White Goods , as more fully described in the Description of Purchased Unit and Appendix C ( together with the “ Purchased Unit ”) ; and 
 
 
 The Developer has agreed to sell , and the Buyer has agree d to purchase, the Purchased Unit on the terms and conditions of this Agreement to Sell. 
 
 
 NOW, THEREFORE, the Parties agree to the following terms and conditions: 
 
 SCOPE AND INTERPRETATION 
 
 For the consideration provided in this Agreement to Sell (defined below), including without limitation the full Purchase Price, the Developer agrees to sell the Purchased Unit to the Buyer, and the Buyer agrees to purchase the Purchased Unit from the Developer, along with all rights, title and interest s of the Developer therein , strictly in accordance with the terms and conditions of this Agreement along with all documents attached hereto, as may be amended from time to time. Provided that where there is more than one person or entity as the “Buyer”, then the obligations of the persons or entities in relation hereto shall be joint and several. 
 
 The following documents (duly acknowledged) together shall constitute the complete and exclusive agreement between the Parties hereto in respect of the sale and purchase of the Purchased Unit, all of which shall form an integral part of the Agreement (the “Agreement” ): 
 
 
 This Agreement to Sell; 
 Schedule A: Description of Purchased Unit &amp; Nominees Form ; 
 Schedule B: General Terms and Conditions hereof ; 
 A ppendix A : Payment Plan; 
 Appendix B: Purchased Unit Floor Plan; 
 Appendix C: Inventory of White Goods ; and 
 Any other document incorporated by reference in this forming part of the Agreement by reference herein pursuant to the terms and conditions thereof . 
 
 The documents enumerated in Clause 2 above shall be taken as mutually explanatory, and in the event of any conflict, ambiguity or discrepancy, unless otherwise specified, priority shall be given to the General Terms and Conditions, followed by the Payment Plan, and Description of Purchased Unit. Any terms used as defined terms shall have the meaning assigned to them in the General Terms and Conditions. The rules of interpretation set out in the General Terms and Conditions shall apply to all documents forming the Agreement. 
 
 
 
 BUYER’S WARRANTIES 
 
 The Buyer confirms having read, understood and agrees to comply with the Agreement at all times and by any further terms and conditions as may be prescribed from time to time by the Developer . 
 
 The Buyer represents and warrants that all details provided by the Buyer in this Agreement are true and correct in all respects. 
 
 
 The Buyer represents and warrants that the Buyer (and where there is more than one Buyer, each such Buyer) has the requisite capacity and authority to enter into the Agreement and to perform the obligations hereunder. 
 
 
 ARBITRATION 
 
 Any dispute or difference as to the Agreement or any part thereof or any matter or thing of whatsoever nature arising thereunder or in relation thereto between the Developer and the Buyer that cannot be resolved through mutual agreement shall be referred to arbitration in accordance with the General Terms and Conditions.

 SCHEDULE B 
 GENERAL TERMS AND CONDITIONS 
 
 DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATION 
 Unless inconsistent with the context, the following words will have the meanings assigned below: 
 
 Agreement means the Agreement to Sell, including these General Terms and Conditions as well as all documents enumerated in Clause 2 of the Agreement to Sell. 
 
 Agreement to Sell means the Agreement to Sell entered into between the Developer and the Buyer to which these General Terms and Conditions are appended. 
 
 Adjusted Amount has the meaning assigned to it in Clause 3.3 of these General Terms and Conditions. 
 
 Buyer means the person or persons identified as the Buyer in the Agreement to Sell and his/her or their respective heirs, executors, administrators, successors, permitted transferees and permitted assigns. Where there is more than one Buyer, references to one Buyer shall be to such persons jointly and severally. 
 
 Common Areas means those parts of the Project not physically forming a part of any Purchased Unit and are intended for the common use of all occupants or owners of all Purchased Units, including inter alia all open areas, elevators, administrative office areas, security system, lobbies, Parking Space and hallways. 
 
 Common Facilities means all roads, pavements, water features, installations, elevators, power backup equipment, security system systems , tube-well motors, improvements and common assets of the Common Areas that are intended for facilitating all occupants and owners of Purchased Units and do not form part of any given Purchased Unit. 
 
 Competent Authority means any federal, provincial, capital or local government or authority, department, local, regulatory, statutory or housing authority and any other authority which has jurisdiction over any aspect or part of the Project or the Agreement. 
 
 Completion or Estimated Completion Date 
 means the date or expected date communicated by the Developer as the date or expected date on which the Purchased Unit will be ready for handover of possession to the Buyer, subject to the Buyer complying with his/her obligations inter alia as per Clause s 3 (Payment) and 5 (Construction and Possession of Purchased Unit ) of these General Terms and Conditions. 
 
 Completion Notice means a written notice sent to the Buyer by the Developer communicating the Completion Date. 
 
 Component Materials means inter alia steel, cement, diesel, labour or any other material used for construction and finishing of the Project. 
 
 Developer means [●] [Developer Name] Developer means D EEVAR DEVELOP ERS (PRIVATE) LIMITED , with its registered office at [Developer’s Address] . 94 B/I, M. M. Alam Road, Gulberg III, Lahore. 
 
 Down Payment means the down payment paid by the Buyer under the Agreement to Sell, as given in the Payment Plan or any other amount as agreed between the Parties in writing . 
 
 Due Date means the date on or before which any payment, including the payments mentioned in the Payment Plan, is required to be paid by the Buyer in the Developer’s designated bank account. 
 
 Event of Force Majeure has the meaning assigned to it in Clause 1 4 .1 REF _Ref98336344 \r \h \* MERGEFORMAT 14.1 of these General Terms and Conditions. 
 
 Furnishings means the furniture items listed in Table C of A ppendix C . 
 
 Instalment Payment means any payment (including Down Payment) to be made by the Buyer as per the Payment Plan. For the avoidance of doubt, Instalment Payment may, subject to Clause 3.3, include any applicable Adjusted Amount. 
 
 License has the meaning assigned to it in Clause 5 . 
 
 Management Company means the entity or entities, which may include the Developer, any of its affiliates or associated companies or any other company (and their respective successors in interest and assigns) charged with the responsibility of maintaining, operating or managing the Project or any part thereof, including, inter alia, the Parking Space, Common Areas and/or Common Facilities. 
 
 Nominee means next of kin or any other person nominated by the Buyer in Schedule A to facilitate in the process of transfer of rights and obligations of the Buyer, under the Agreement to Sell and/or with respect to the Purchased Unit, to the Buyer’s legal heirs, in the event of demise of the Buyer. 
 
 Parking Space means the parking space allocated for the exclusive use of the Buyer or occupants of the Purchased Unit . 
 
 Party refers to either one of the parties to this Agreement , whereas Parties refers to both. 
 
 Payment Plan means the Payment Plan in Appendix A A ppendix A of the Agreement to Sell , setting out the Due Date, quantum and schedule of Installment Payments of the Purchase Price to be paid by the Buyer to the Developer . 
 
 Permitted Use means the permi tted nature and use of the Purchased Unit as per the Purchased Unit type specified in the Description of the Purchased Unit a residential unit , strictly in accordance with the Rules (defined below) . 
 
 Project means the real estate project , named and styled as ‘ [Project Name] ’ , being ‘ Zameen Opal ’, constructed and developed by the Developer at [Project Location] . Plot No. 16 and 17, Land Breeze Society, Raiwind Road, Lahore . 
 
 Purchase Price means the total amount payable by the Buyer to purchase the Purchased Unit (exclusive of tax ) including Component Materials, White Goods (as specified in Appendix C ), in the manner and in such instalments, as identified in the Payment Plan in Appendix A to the Agreement to Sell , as may be modified in terms hereof including under Clause 9.2 and any Adjusted Amount in terms of Clause 3.3 of the Agreement . 
 
 Purchased Unit means the fully constructed unit specifically described in Schedule A and shown in the Purchased Unit Floor Plan, including White Goods, which the Buyer has contracted to purchase pursuant to the Agreement. 
 
 Purchased Unit Floor 
 Plan means the floor plan of the Purchased Unit and its location, as shown in Appendix B to the Agreement to Sell. 
 
 Rules means such rules as may be framed by the Developer and/or the Management Company and amended from time to time setting out the Buyer’s (or anyone occupying the Purchased Unit other than the Buyer) rights and obligations in relation to the transfer/resale, use, occupancy, layout, maintenance, design and display of the all Purchased Units. 
 
 Service Charges Advance means the Service Charges payable by the Buyer to the Management Company in advance a s on the date of grant of License under Clause 5 Completion of the General Terms and Conditions . 
 
 Service Charges means m eans the amount payable by the Buyer or occupants , in the designated bank account of the Management Company from time to time, for the use and upkeep of Common Areas, Common Facilities, and/or Parking Space s of the Project . 
 White Goods means the household appliances provided in the Purchased Unit(s) as specified in Appendix C.

 Any statute or other legislative provision shall be read to include any statutory or legislative modification, amendment or re-enactment thereof; 
 
 
 Words denoting one gender shall include all other genders; 
 
 
 Words denoting singular shall, where the context permits, include plural; 
 
 
 Any reference to a date or time is to such date and time in Islamabad, Pakistan; 
 
 
 Any reference to a Party shall, where the context permits, mean and include its successors-in-interest and permitted assigns; 
 
 
 No rule of construction shall apply to the disadvantage of a Party because that Party was responsible for the preparation of the Agreement or any part of the Agreement;
